title: AlphaFold2 essentially solved a 50-year grand challenge
body: At CASP14 in 2020 AlphaFold2 predicted protein structures with accuracy competitive with experiments for many targets, stunning assessors who had scored incremental progress for decades. Folding went from bottleneck to database: DeepMind and EMBL later released predictions for over two hundred million proteins. One benchmark result restructured daily practice in biology labs worldwide.
source_hint: Jumper et al., Nature (2021); AlphaFold DB
